Looking at this question, I need to consider the known immunomodulatory effects of bone marrow stromal cell (BMSC)-conditioned media on T cells, specifically OT-1 T cells (which are CD8+ T cells that recognize ovalbumin peptide in the context of MHC class I).

BMSCs are well-known for their immunosuppressive properties. Studies examining the effects of BMSC-conditioned media on OT-1 T cells have shown that the conditioned media can modulate T cell surface marker expression as part of the immunoregulatory mechanism. Specifically, research has demonstrated that BMSC-conditioned media leads to a decrease in CD8a receptor expression on OT-1 T cells, consistent with the broader immunosuppressive effects of BMSCs on cytotoxic T cell function.

This downregulation of CD8a is part of the mechanism by which BMSCs dampen T cell-mediated immune responses.

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
